source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 5 (PDF 126-152), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 5 (Data Analytics) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 8 number ka hai (definition, misalon ke saath wazahat, farq, program likh kar samjhana), aksar definition aur wazahat ke hisson mein (jaise 2 + 3 x 2). Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Models are used to understand problems and make decisions. (i) Define a model and explain it with the map analogy. (2) (ii) Explain how a model helps in decision making, with the farmer's example. (2) (iii) Describe how models are applied in weather forecasting, financial predictions and scientific research. (4) (8 marks)
(Model masail samajhne aur faisle karne mein kaam aate hain. (i) Model ki definition map ki misaal se wazeh karein. (ii) Faisla karne mein model ki madad kisan ki misaal se batayein. (iii) Weather forecasting, financial predictions aur scientific research mein model ka istemal bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Model: kisi mushkil masle ya surat-e-haal ko saada tareeqe se dekhne ka zariya. Yeh samajhne, wazeh karne ya peshgoi (prediction) mein madad deta hai. Jaise naqsha (map) sirf sarakain aur nishaniyan dikha kar shehar mein raasta batata hai, waise hi model aham hisson par tawajjuh de kar aur ghair zaroori tafseel chhor kar masla samjhata hai. Misaal: study plan aham subjects par tawajjuh de kar schedule saada banata hai.

(ii) Faisla: model masle par munazzam tareeqe se sochne deta hai, mushkil maloomat aasan banata hai aur faisle se pehle mukhtalif nataij par ghaur karwata hai. Misaal: mausam ke patterns aur mitti ki halat parh kar model kisan ko fasal lagane ka sahi waqt batata hai, jis se achhi fasal ka imkaan barhta hai.

(iii) Istemal:
1. Weather forecasting: meteorologists temperature, humidity aur hawa ki raftaar jama kar ke model se mausam ki peshgoi karte hain.
2. Financial predictions: banks aur companies economic trends, stock prices aur customers ke rawayye ki peshgoi karte hain.
3. Scientific research: model theories test karne, naye khayalat dhoondne aur data par peshgoi mein madad dete hain. ML aur AI ki taraqqi se model bare data ke tajziye mein aur taqatwar aur durust ho gaye hain.

book_ref.quote: They are widely used in various fields to make predictions and decisions based on available data

blocks.prompt:
2 Measures of central tendency describe the typical value of data. (i) Define measures of central tendency and name them. (2) (ii) Explain the mean, the median (odd and even number of values) and the mode (one and more modes), finding each for the data 4, 9, 9, 6, 12, 2, 6 and for 4, 9, 9, 6, 12, 2. (6) (8 marks)
(Central tendency ke paimane data ki aam value batate hain. (i) Definition aur naam likhein. (ii) Mean, median (taaq aur juft values) aur mode (aik aur zyada modes) wazeh karein aur data 4, 9, 9, 6, 12, 2, 6 aur 4, 9, 9, 6, 12, 2 ke liye nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Central tendency (markazi rujhan) ke paimane data ki markazi ya aam value batate hain. Teen bare paimane: mean, median aur mode.

(ii) Mean: sab numbers ka average; jama kar ke tadaad se taqseem.
Data A: jama 48, mean = 48/7 ≈ 6.86.
Data B: jama 42, mean = 42/6 = 7.

Median: tarteeb ke baad beech wali value. Taaq tadaad par beech wala number; juft tadaad par do beech walon ka average.
Data A: 2, 4, 6, 6, 9, 9, 12 (7 values), median = 6.
Data B: 2, 4, 6, 9, 9, 12 (6 values), median = (6 + 9)/2 = 7.5.

Mode: sab se zyada aane wala number; barabar sab se zyada frequency ho to aik se zyada mode.
Data A: 6 aur 9 do do dafa, do modes 6 aur 9.
Data B: sirf 9 do dafa, mode 9.

book_ref.quote: If there is an even number of values, the median is the average of the two middle numbers

blocks.prompt:
3 Two sections took the same test. Section X scored 62, 64, 66, 68, 70 and Section Y scored 40, 55, 65, 80, 90. Define measures of dispersion, then find the variance and standard deviation of both sections and say which section's scores are more spread out. (8 marks)
(Do sections ne aik test diya. Section X: 62, 64, 66, 68, 70; Section Y: 40, 55, 65, 80, 90. Dispersion ki definition likhein, dono ka variance aur standard deviation nikalein aur batayein kis section ke scores zyada phele hue hain.)
blocks.explanation: Dispersion ke paimane batate hain ke data kitna phela hua hai, yani values mean ke qareeb hain ya door. σ² = (1/N) Σ (xᵢ − μ)² aur σ = √σ².

book_ref.quote: These help us understand whether the data points are close to the average (mean) or far from it

steps: Dono ka mean 66 hai, magar Section Y ka variance kahin zyada hai, is liye us ke scores zyada phele hue hain; Section X ke scores mean ke qareeb hain.
blocks.final_answer: Section X: variance 8, SD ≈ 2.83. Section Y: variance 314, SD ≈ 17.72. Section Y zyada phela hua hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Dono sections ka mean barabar (66) hai, is liye sirf mean se farq pata nahin chalta. Variance aur standard deviation batate hain ke values mean se kitni door hain: X ki values 62 se 70 tak qareeb qareeb hain, Y ki 40 se 90 tak phaili hain.

blocks.prompt:
4 The hours spent on homework in a week by 10 classmates are 3, 5, 8, 8, 10, 12, 15, 15, 16, 18. Calculate the mean, median and mode, and then the variance and standard deviation. State what these values tell about the study habits. (8 marks)
(10 hum-jamaaton ke hafte ke homework ke ghante 3, 5, 8, 8, 10, 12, 15, 15, 16, 18 hain. Mean, median, mode, phir variance aur standard deviation nikalein. Batayein ke yeh values parhai ki aadaton ke bare mein kya batati hain.)
blocks.explanation: Central tendency ke usool, phir σ² = (1/N) Σ (xᵢ − μ)² aur σ = √σ².

book_ref.quote: For illustration, you can use the following sample data: 3, 5, 8, 8, 10, 12, 15, 15, 16, 18

steps: Median: data tarteeb mein hai; 10 values (juft), median = (10 + 12)/2 = 11 ghante.
Mode: 8 aur 15 do do dafa, do modes 8 aur 15.
Nateeja: aam tor par 11 ghante; taqreeban 4.75 ki standard deviation batati hai ke ghante kaafi phele hue hain (3 se 18).
blocks.final_answer: Mean = 11, median = 11, modes = 8 aur 15, variance = 22.6, standard deviation ≈ 4.75 ghante.

blocks.prompt:
5 Statistics summarizes data and predicts outcomes. (i) What are descriptive statistics? Summarize the scores 50, 65, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, 60, 70, 88 by their mean, highest and lowest score. (4) (ii) Define probability, write its formula, apply it to tossing a coin and name three areas where probability is used. (4) (8 marks)
(Statistics data ka khulasa aur nataij ki peshgoi karti hai. (i) Descriptive statistics kya hain? Diye gaye scores ka mean, sab se zyada aur sab se kam score se khulasa karein. (ii) Probability ki definition, formula, sikke par istemal aur teen shobe batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Descriptive statistics data ka khulasa aur tarteeb dete hain; har value dekhne ke bajaye poori tasveer dikhate hain.
Mean = 758/10 = 75.8; sab se zyada 95; sab se kam 50. In hisabon se talaba ki karkardagi ka fori khulasa milta hai.

(ii) Probability yeh mutaala hai ke koi waqiya hone ka kitna imkaan hai; is se nataij ki peshgoi hoti hai.
Probability = favourable nataij / kul nataij
Sikka: do barabar imkaan wale nataij, heads ya tails; P(heads) = 1/2 = 50%, P(tails) = 1/2 = 50%.
Istemal: mausam ki peshgoi, karobari faisle aur cricket.

book_ref.quote: Probability is the study of how likely an event is to happen

blocks.prompt:
6 Different research needs different ways of gathering data. (i) Define data collection and state what the choice of method depends on. (2) (ii) Explain surveys, observations and experiments, giving the chapter's example of each. (6) (8 marks)
(Mukhtalif tehqeeq ke liye data jama karne ke mukhtalif tareeqe hain. (i) Data collection ki definition aur tareeqe ke chunao ki bunyad batayein. (ii) Surveys, observations aur experiments chapter ki misaalon ke sath wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Data collection kisi khaas maqsad ke liye mutalliqa maloomat jama karne ka amal hai. Tareeqe: surveys, observations aur experiments. Sahi tareeqa research ke maqsad aur zaroori data ki qisam par munhasir hai.

(ii) 1. Surveys: sample group se pehle se tay sawal poochh kar munazzam tareeqe se bohat sa data; online forms, telephone ya aamne saamne interview se.
Misaal: Islamabad ki grocery store ne weekend par 50 customers ko paanch sawalon ka survey diya aur un ki pasand ke products rakhe.

2. Observations: logon ya cheezon ko qudrati mahol mein dekh kar ya nigrani kar ke, baghair dakhal.
Misaal: restaurant ke staff ne aik hafta dekha ke dopehar ko kaun si tables chuni jati hain, phir seating behtar ki.

3. Experiments: aik ya zyada variables badal kar doosre variable par asar dekhna; science aur engineering mein jahan controlled mahol zaroori ho.
Misaal: teacher ne aik group ko printed notes diye, doosre ko sirf lectures; aik maah baad aik hi test le kar nataij milaye.

book_ref.quote: Depending on the nature of the research, different methods can be used for data collection

blocks.prompt:
7 Collected data must be made ready before analysis. (i) What is data preparation? (2) (ii) Explain data cleaning with the school grade records of Table 5.2. (3) (iii) Explain data transformation and differentiate it from data cleaning. (3) (8 marks)
(Jama kiya gaya data tajziye se pehle tayyar karna zaroori hai. (i) Data preparation kya hai? (ii) Table 5.2 ke grade records se data cleaning wazeh karein. (iii) Data transformation wazeh karein aur cleaning se farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Data preparation: jama data ko tajziye ke liye tayyar karna: ghaltiyan hatana, ba-maani tarteeb dena aur munasib format mein badalna; ghayab/ghalat data ke liye interpolation ya statistical adjustments. Is se nataij reliable aur valid hote hain.

(ii) Data cleaning: data ke masail (ghalat entries, missing values, duplicates) theek karna ya hatana; warna nataij gumrah-kun honge.
Misaal (Table 5.2): "Alie" ko "Ali" kiya gaya aur Sara ka missing grade (75) bhara gaya, is tarah data mukammal hua.

(iii) Data transformation: saaf data ko aasan format mein badalna, jaise format badalna, naye columns banana ya nayi tarteeb; is se data tajziye ya modelling ke qabil banta hai.

book_ref.quote: It shows examples of common issues such as incorrect names, missing grades, and duplicate entries

rows: Data ke masail theek karna ya hatana.
Saaf data ko aasan format mein badalna.
Cleaning ke baad, tajziye ke liye.

blocks.prompt:
8 In a dataset of student grades, Sara's grade is missing. (i) Why is missing data a problem and what does the choice of a technique depend on? (2) (ii) Explain imputation, flagging and removal, applying each to Sara's record, with one advantage or risk of each. (6) (8 marks)
(Talaba ke grades ke data mein Sara ka grade missing hai. (i) Missing data masla kyon hai aur technique ka chunao kis par munhasir hai? (ii) Imputation, flagging aur removal Sara ke record par laga kar, har aik ka faida ya khatra batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Missing values data ko na-mukammal banati hain; jaise Sara ka grade na ho to us ki karkardagi jaanchna mushkil hai. Kam rows hon to hata di jati hain, warna average ya milte julte cases se bhari jati hain. Chunao data ki qisam aur missing maloomat ki miqdar par hai.

(ii) 1. Imputation: mojooda data se andaza; class ka average 82 ho to filhal Sara ko 82. Faida: data mukammal rehta hai aur andaza maqool hota hai.

2. Flagging: note lagaya jata hai ke Sara ka grade mojood nahin. Faida: shaffafiyat (transparency); khala bhare baghair tajziya chalta hai.

3. Removal: missing entries kam hon to Sara ka record kuch tajziyon se nikal diya jata hai, agar majmooi samajh par asar na pare. Khatra: Sara ki qeemti maloomat kho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Sometimes, data is incomplete or has missing values

blocks.prompt:
9 Statistical models help in planning a family budget. (i) Define statistical modeling and explain it with the grocery expense example. (3) (ii) Give four suggestions for improving a statistical model and explain why each helps. (5) (8 marks)
(Statistical models ghar ka budget banane mein madad dete hain. (i) Statistical modeling ki definition grocery kharch ki misaal se wazeh karein. (ii) Statistical model behtar karne ki chaar tajaweez aur un ka faida batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Statistical modeling data se duniya samajhne aur mustaqbil ki peshgoi karne ka tareeqa hai. Agle maah ka grocery kharch jaanne ke liye pichla kharch dekh kar model banaya jata hai. Agar aam tor par 10,000 rupay maahana kharch ho magar upar neeche hota ho, to model khandan ke size ya khaas mauqon jaise factors shamil kar ke behtar budget batata hai.

(ii) 1. Zyada data points: behtar durusti.
2. Mutalliqa factors (khandan ka size, khaas mauqe) shamil karna: kharch ki asal wajoohat model mein aati hain.
3. Naye data se baqaidagi se update: model relevant rehta hai.
4. Peshgoi ko asal kharch se milana: error pata chal kar tareeqa behtar hota hai.

book_ref.quote: If you usually spend around 10,000 rupees each month, but your expenses fluctuate

blocks.prompt:
10 A tea stall recorded these data for five days (customers, earnings in rupees): (5, 300), (10, 450), (15, 600), (20, 750), (25, 900). Write the simple linear regression formula and explain its terms. Find the slope and intercept, write the final equation, predict the earnings for 22 customers, and find the error if on another day 26 customers gave earnings of 920 rupees. (8 marks)
(Chai ke stall ka paanch din ka data (customers, kamai rupay mein): (5, 300), (10, 450), (15, 600), (20, 750), (25, 900). Linear regression ka formula aur terms likhein; slope, intercept aur equation nikalein; 22 customers ki kamai batayein, aur 26 customers par asal kamai 920 ho to error nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Y = β₀ + β₁X + ε: Y dependent variable (kamai), X independent variable (customers), β₀ intercept (X = 0 par Y), β₁ slope (X ki har ikai par Y ki tabdeeli), ε error term (peshgoi aur asal ka farq).

book_ref.quote: To build a linear regression model, we need data

steps: Slope: har 5 izafi customers par kamai 150 rupay barhti hai, β₁ = 150/5 = 30 rupay fi customer.
Equation: Earnings = 150 + 30 × Customers (koi customer na ho to 150; har customer 30 rupay).
Jaanch: 25 customers par 150 + 750 = 900, data se milta hai.
Test: 26 customers par model 150 + 780 = 930 rupay batata hai.
Error = 930 − 920 = 10 rupay; peshgoi qareeb hai magar asal data mein kuch farq hota hai.
blocks.final_answer: β₁ = 30, β₀ = 150, Earnings = 150 + 30 × Customers; 22 customers → 810 rupay; error = 10 rupay.

blocks.prompt:
11 Logistic regression predicts yes/no outcomes. Explain how logistic regression differs from linear regression and explain the terms of the logistic function. A fitted model is P(pass) = 1 / (1 + e^−(−3 + 1 × Hours Studied)). Find the probability of passing for 2, 3 and 5 hours of study and interpret the results. (8 marks)
(Logistic regression haan/na nataij ki peshgoi karti hai. Linear regression se farq aur logistic function ki terms wazeh karein. Model P(pass) = 1 / (1 + e^−(−3 + 1 × Hours)) se 2, 3 aur 5 ghanton ki pass probability nikalein aur tashreeh karein.)
blocks.explanation: Logistic regression haan ya na nateeje ke liye hai; theek number nahin balke 0 aur 1 ke darmiyan probability deti hai. P(pass) pass hone ki probability, e natural logarithm ki base, β₀ intercept (zero ghanton par log-odds), β₁ ghanton ka coefficient (har izafi ghante par log-odds ki tabdeeli).

book_ref.quote: Instead of giving a specific score, logistic regression helps us find the probability of passing

steps: Tashreeh: har probability 0 aur 1 ke darmiyan hai, aur β₁ musbat hai is liye har izafi ghante se pass hone ka imkaan barhta hai.
blocks.final_answer: P(2) ≈ 0.27, P(3) = 0.5, P(5) ≈ 0.88; zyada ghante, zyada imkaan.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: e^1 ≈ 2.718 aur e^−2 ≈ 0.135 calculator se. Jab exponent wala hissa (β₀ + β₁ × Hours) zero ho to probability theek 0.5 hoti hai; musbat ho to 0.5 se zyada, manfi ho to kam.

blocks.prompt:
12 A model is useful only if it performs well and is used responsibly. (i) Differentiate between error metrics and accuracy metrics with an example of each, and explain what interpreting a model's output means. (4) (ii) Explain the ethical considerations of fairness and data privacy in building models. (4) (8 marks)
(Model tab hi mufeed hai jab achha kaam kare aur zimmedari se istemal ho. (i) Error aur accuracy metrics ka farq misaal ke sath likhein aur output interpret karne ka matlab batayein. (ii) Fairness aur data privacy ke akhlaqi pehlu wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Performance metrics batate hain ke model kitna achha kaam kar raha hai.
Output interpret karna yani samajhna ke nataij kya batate hain aur nateeja nikalna; jaise ghante scores par gehra asar dalein to zyada parhna chahiye.

(ii) Akhlaqi pehlu:
1. Fairness aur bias: model munsifana ho; qarz ka model kisi group ko be-insafi se tarjeeh na de.
2. Data privacy: zaati data mehfooz rahe aur ijazat ke baghair share na ho.

book_ref.quote: In our grocery example, if the model predicts a monthly grocery bill of 8,000 rupees but the actual bill is 10,000 rupees

rows: Peshgoi aur asal value ka farq.
Misaal: bill 8,000 bataya, asal 10,000; farq 2,000 rupay error.
Misaal: pass/fail model kitni dafa sahi tha.

blocks.prompt:
13 A retail shop has six customers with monthly spending (groceries, clothing) in $: C1 (150, 100), C2 (200, 150), C3 (100, 50), C4 (80, 20), C5 (160, 90), C6 (40, 10). Using K = 2 with initial centres C2 and C6, carry out K-means clustering with the Euclidean distance until the centres stop changing, and describe the two groups. (8 marks)
(Dukaan ke chhe customers ka maahana kharch (groceries, clothing) $ mein diya hai. K = 2, shuru ke centres C2 aur C6 le kar Euclidean distance se K-means tab tak chalayein jab tak centres na badlein, aur dono groups bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: K-means: K chunein, shuru ke centres rakhein, har point ko qareeb tareen centre (Euclidean distance) ke cluster mein dalein, har cluster ka average naya centre banayein, aur centres na badlne tak dohrayein.

book_ref.quote: Your task is to use K-means clustering to group these customers into two clusters based on their spending habits

steps: C1, C2, C5 Centre 1 ke qareeb; C3, C4, C6 Centre 2 ke qareeb.
Koi customer cluster nahin badalta, is liye centres ruk gaye aur clusters mustahkam hain.
Cluster 1 (C1, C2, C5) dono cheezon par zyada kharch karta hai; Cluster 2 (C3, C4, C6) dono par kam.
blocks.final_answer: Cluster 1 = C1, C2, C5 (zyada kharch); Cluster 2 = C3, C4, C6 (kam kharch).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misaal ke tor par C1 ka Centre 1 se faasla: √((200 − 150)² + (150 − 100)²) = √(2500 + 2500) = √5000 ≈ 70.71. Har round mein pehle faasle, phir naye centres; jab koi point group na badle to algorithm ruk jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
14 Choosing the right chart makes data easy to understand. (i) Define data visualization and state how it helps. (2) (ii) Choose a suitable visualization for each case and give the reason: comparing sales of different products; temperature over a week; distribution of maths exam scores; hours studied against exam scores; comparing the scores of three classes. (6) (8 marks)
(Sahi chart data ko aasan bana deta hai. (i) Data visualization ki definition aur faida likhein. (ii) Har surat ke liye munasib visualization aur wajah batayein: products ki sales; hafte ka temperature; maths scores ki taqseem; ghante aur scores; teen classes ke scores.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Data visualization data ko graphs ya charts ki shakal mein pesh karna hai; is se patterns, trends aur insights jaldi samajh aate hain.

(ii) 1. Products ki sales: bar chart; categories ka muqabla, har bar ki unchai sales.
2. Hafte ka temperature: line graph; waqt ke sath trend, points line se jure.
3. Maths scores ki taqseem: histogram; scores bins/intervals mein, har range ki frequency.
4. Ghante aur scores: scatterplot; do variables ka talluq, har point aik talib-e-ilm.
5. Teen classes ke scores: boxplot (whisker plot); median, quartiles aur outliers se muqabla.

book_ref.quote: It helps us to quickly grasp patterns, trends, and insights from data

blocks.prompt:
15 A shopkeeper wants to track monthly sales. (i) Why are Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets suitable tools for this? (2) (ii) Write the steps to create a bar chart of monthly sales in Excel or Google Sheets. (4) (iii) How would you interpret a bar chart and a line graph of these sales? (2) (8 marks)
(Dukaandar maahana sales dekhna chahta hai. (i) Excel aur Google Sheets is ke liye kyon munasib hain? (ii) Maahana sales ka bar chart banane ke qadam likhein. (iii) Bar chart aur line graph ki tashreeh kaise karenge?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Excel aur Google Sheets aam dastiyab aur jaane pehchane hain aur charts banane ke seedhe tareeqe dete hain; data darj kar ke chand clicks mein bar charts, line graphs aur pie charts ban jate hain.

(ii) 1. Data darj karein: aik column mein maheene, doosre mein har maheene ki sales.
2. Data select karein: mouse se cells par click aur drag kar ke highlight.
3. Chart type: Insert tab par click kar ke bar chart chunein.
4. Customize: labels lagayein, x-axis par maheene, y-axis par sales, taa ke chart saaf ho.

(iii) Bar chart categories ka muqabla karta hai, is liye sab se zyada sales wala maheena dikhata hai. Line graph waqt ke sath trend dikhata hai, yani kayi maheenon mein sales ka barhna ya ghatna.

book_ref.quote: Understanding Statistical Representations: When you create a visualization
